column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:cli module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# aql:cli — conventional command-line argument parsing (design/CLI-PROGRAMS.0.md
# §8, design/CLI-PROGRAMS.1.md §2-3), implemented in AQL
# (lang/go/modules/cli.aql). A spec map drives four words:
#   Cli.parse    (spec) (argv)  -> {ok flags args command} | {ok:false err usage}
#   Cli.dispatch (spec) (argv)  -> {action code out err flags args command}
#   Cli.usage    (spec)         -> the generated help text
#   Cli.main     (spec) (h)     -> the imperative shell (NOT spec-testable: every
#                                  arm ends in IO.exit, which would end the
#                                  runner — hermeticExempt names the Go tests)
# argv is ALWAYS an explicit parameter, never an internal IO.args read: `aql
# test` and the spec runner cannot inject an argument vector, so a parser that
# read it internally would be untestable by construction.
# Every row leads with `import "aql:cli"`. parse / dispatch / usage are PURE —
# no IO, no environment, no raising — so every row here runs with nothing
# installed, which is what makes the flag grammar spec-pinnable at all.
# §1  the flag grammar — long, short, clustered, =value, --no-X, --
import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--v"]).flags).v
column3: a long bool flag sets true

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"verbose" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-v"]).flags).verbose
column3: the short spelling of the same flag

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--kind" "csv"]).flags).kind
column3: --long value takes the following token

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--kind=csv"]).flags).kind
column3: --long=value takes it inline

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--kind="]).flags).kind
column3: an empty inline value is a real empty string

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-k" "tsv"]).flags).kind
column3: -s value takes the following token

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"verbose" short:"v" kind:"count"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-vvv"]).flags).verbose
column3: a clustered count flag counts occurrences

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"a" short:"a" kind:"bool"} {name:"b" short:"b" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-ab"]).flags).b
column3: clustered shorts set each flag

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"watch" short:"w" kind:"bool" default:true}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--no-watch"]).flags).watch
column3: --no-X clears a bool

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--" "-v" "x"]).args
column3: a bare -- ends flag processing

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-"]).args
column3: a lone - is a positional, not a flag

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--kind" "a" "--kind" "b"]).flags).kind
column3: a repeated string flag collects into a List

column1: # §2  defaults — a flag the argv never mentioned still answers
import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"watch" short:"w" kind:"bool" default:true}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).flags).watch
column3: a declared default fills an unmentioned flag

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).flags).kind
column3: an unmentioned string flag with no default is none

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"verbose" short:"v" kind:"count"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).flags).verbose
column3: an unmentioned count flag is 0

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).ok
column3: an empty argv parses cleanly

column1: # §3  errors are DATA — the parse never raises
import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--wach"]).ok
column3: an unknown long flag fails

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--kind"]).ok
column3: a value-taking flag with no value fails

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:1}} []).ok
column3: fewer positionals than min fails

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0 max:1}} ["a" "b"]).ok
column3: more positionals than max fails

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--wach"]).err) neq ''
column3: a failed parse carries a one-line error

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[{name:"v" short:"v" kind:"bool"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--wach"]).usage) neq ''
column3: and the usage text to print beside it

column1: # §4  Cli.dispatch — the decision a driver acts on
import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).action
column3: an ordinary argv dispatches to run

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).code
column3: whose exit code is 0

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--help"]).action
column3: --help is an action, not an error

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["-h"]).action
column3: and so is its short spelling

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--version"]).action
column3: --version likewise

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--version"]).code
column3: both exit 0

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--nope"]).action
column3: an unknown flag is the error action

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--nope"]).code
column3: with the conventional usage-error status 2

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--version"]).out) neq ''
column3: the version action carries the text to print

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--nope"]).err) neq ''
column3: the error action carries stderr text

column1: import "aql:cli"  ((Cli.dispatch {name:"t" version:"1.0" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} []).out)
column3: the run action prints nothing of its own

column1: # §5  Cli.usage — generated, and it names what the spec declared
import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "tool" (Cli.usage {name:"tool" version:"2.1" summary:"does a thing" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}}))
column3: the usage text names the program

column1: import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "does a thing" (Cli.usage {name:"tool" version:"2.1" summary:"does a thing" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}}))
column3: and its summary

column1: import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "--kind" (Cli.usage {name:"tool" version:"2.1" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string" value:"KIND" help:"the parser"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}}))
column3: each declared flag appears

column1: import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "the parser" (Cli.usage {name:"tool" version:"2.1" flags:[{name:"kind" short:"k" kind:"string" value:"KIND" help:"the parser"}] args:{name:"f" min:0}}))
column3: with its help text

column1: import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "--help" (Cli.usage {name:"tool" version:"2.1" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}}))
column3: the implicit --help is documented too

column1: # §6  the spec map is data — an absent field takes its default
import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["a"]).args
column3: a spec with no flags still parses positionals

column1: import "aql:cli"  (Cli.parse {name:"t" flags:[]} ["a" "b"]).ok
column3: a spec with no args block accepts any positionals

column1: import "aql:cli"  import "aql:string-util"  (StringUtil.contains "t" ((Cli.dispatch {name:"t" flags:[] args:{name:"f" min:0}} ["--version"]).out))
column3: a spec with no version still answers --version
